ground_truth.description: Switching Pyth entropy providers mid-draw allows attacker to select a malicious provider returning predetermined numbers.
ground_truth.root_cause: Switching Pyth entropy providers mid-draw allows attacker to select a malicious provider returning predetermined numbers.
ground_truth.fix_description: Freeze entropy provider changes while a draw is active.

prediction.overall_explanation: The ScaledEntropyProvider contract is a well-designed entropy service that integrates with Pyth Network. It implements proper security measures including input validation, ownership controls, and callback verification. The contract correctly handles entropy requests, stores pending requests securely, and executes callbacks safely. All critical functions include appropriate validations for addresses, selectors, ranges, and fees. The entropy callback mechanism properly validates sequences and cleans up pending requests after successful execution. No exploitable vulnerabilities were found in the code.
